title: Saved Heat comparison after repeated CAD and solver execution
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Open the proof workspace, click Workflows, choose the saved heat workflow and click Use saved process.

manualSteps.label: Attach second run
manualSteps.instruction: Open the third recorded run link and inspect its CAD, analysis and held assessment results.

manualSteps.label: Reuse
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, select Heat-spreader candidate comparison and click Open saved interface. Inspect the full results; leave human reviews untouched.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the working interface and inspect the same third-run results and held assessment.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the heat workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted heat workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted heat workflow is listed.

steps.label: Heat workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original heat assignment opens with its connected review, CAD and analysis stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted heat workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted heat diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved heat source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual heat run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded heat run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Common view shows the exact completed digital chain
steps.summary: The recorded CAD and solver results are visible with the final human-review hold.
steps.purpose: Check common-view parity against the authoritative third-run contract.
steps.action: Inspect all recorded common-view result cards; leave reviews untouched.
steps.expected: All eighteen exact third-run results, with no substituted earlier evidence.
steps.actual: All result identities match the third-run API contract.

steps.label: Saved updated comparison shows identical evidence
steps.summary: The previously built comparison groups the actual third-run geometry, fields and checks.
steps.purpose: Prove unchanged saved-interface reuse with common/tailored result identity parity.
steps.action: Choose the saved Heat comparison and click Open saved interface.
steps.expected: The saved updated revision displays exactly the same eighteen third-run result identities.
steps.actual: Exact common/tailored identity parity and all three comparison groups are visible.
